page.layout: One column of running text, set in a single block. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre; page number at top left. Catchword "cap." at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: rethæ [?]1527. Sic & antiqvi Christiani brevissimos si cum hodiernis compares. Sed ista peculiarem meditationem po-stulant. Librum Zohar nihili facio. Recens enim est à quodam Leone Judæo, ante trecentos paulo minus annos con-fictus & evulgatus. Hujus libri ante hoc tempus, Judæorum nemo meminit, at-que ego in eum inquirens, plurima no-vitatis, certissima argumenta deprehen-di.
Verùm his omnibus dimissis, qua-tuor argumentorum genera præter illa, quæ jam allata sunt ibi, proponam, quo-rum vim & consequentiam maximè ve-lim consideres, antequam solutionem eorum aggrediaris.
Magna enim con-tendentium pars rimam potius, quam e-labatur, attendit, quàm intimam obje-cti cognitionem & complexionis neces-sitatem.

Primum desumptum est, ex variis Talmudis & Midraschim locis, in quibus quæstio est de varia lectione iis-dem manentibus literis. Exempli cau-sa Beth Israël f. 158. cap. 3. ex Tract. [illegible, ~2 letters] עבוד[?] vide misna & Ghemar. f. 29. p. 2. cap.

page.notes: Page number 532 read from the top left; running head "JOH. MORINUS". The first line "rethæ 1527." is read as 1527 but is uncertain. The Hebrew word after "Tract." is illegible; the Hebrew word before "vide" is doubtful. "cap." at the lower right is treated as the catchword. No marginal notes are printed.
